Flagship programme · 12-Month Structured Learning Roadmap · Q1 → Q4

The Complete AI & Data Science Mastery Track

A structured, mentor-guided 12-month programme that takes you from absolute beginner to job-ready AI professional: 16 courses across four quarters, four capstone projects, a bundled internship certificate and placement assistance. Live online, recorded for replay, with quarterly offline bootcamps in Chennai and guidance for the Microsoft Azure AI-900 / DP-900 certifications.

  • 16 courses across 4 structured quarters
  • 4 capstone projects — one per quarter
  • 3 live sessions a week, recorded for replay
  • Dedicated mentor with weekly 1-on-1 check-ins
  • Internship certificate bundled — no separate application
  • Placement assistance: resume, LinkedIn, mock interviews
Duration: 12 Months (4 Quarters) Certificate: DSA AI Mastery Certificate + Internship Certificate Prerequisites: none — 10–12 hours a week

NEP & AICTE Aligned
Real projects · Ph.D. mentors · Offer letter

Internships

Structured 1–2 month data science and AI internships aligned with NEP 2020 and AICTE guidelines. Work on real projects under Ph.D.-qualified mentors and leave with a certificate, offer letter and project portfolio.

  • Six domains: ML, data analytics, computer vision, NLP & GenAI, research, software tools
  • DSA Internship Certificate + formal Offer Letter
  • AICTE-aligned where your institution is accredited
  • Online or hybrid, with offline workshops in Chennai
⏱ 1–2 months · cohorts start monthly→
Microsoft Certified
Azure · Power BI · MCT collaboration

Microsoft Certification Program

Focused preparation for Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, delivered in collaboration with Microsoft Certified Trainers — hands-on Azure labs, practice question banks and timed mock exams.

  • AI-900 Azure AI Fundamentals and DP-900 Data Fundamentals
  • PL-300 Power BI Data Analyst prep; AZ-900 as an add-on
  • MCT-led sessions with Azure portal labs
  • Timed mock exams and exam-strategy sessions
⏱ 4–8 weeks per certification→
FDP / MDP
FDP / MDP · AICTE-aligned

Corporate & Faculty Development Program

AICTE-aligned faculty development and corporate training in AI, machine learning, Power BI and Generative AI — from a two-day workshop to a four-week programme, on campus, on site or online.

  • FDPs on AI, ML, data science and research tools
  • Corporate MDP: Power BI, Generative AI, Python, Azure and AWS
  • Train-the-Trainer and Industry 4.0 workshops
  • Needs assessment first; MOU-based partnerships available
⏱ 2 days to 4 weeks · customisable→
Exam Coaching
UGC NET · GATE · TNSET · PG-TRB

Competitive Examination Training

UGC NET, GATE, TNSET and PG-TRB coaching in Computer Science, taught by faculty who have cleared these examinations themselves — with weekly mock tests and personalised performance reports.

  • UGC NET / NET JRF, GATE CS · IT · DS & AI, TNSET, PG-TRB
  • Topic weightage from 5+ years of previous papers
  • Weekly timed tests and full-length mock exams
  • Regular batches or intensive crash courses

Research Support

Research Assistance & Interdisciplinary Guidance

End-to-end research support for Ph.D. scholars, faculty and independent researchers — from domain mapping and proposal writing to statistical analysis, proofreading and journal submission.

  • Topic finalisation, literature review and proposal writing
  • Statistical analysis in SPSS, R and Python
  • Journal targeting: Scopus, Web of Science, UGC Care
  • Technical support for Humanities, Education and Social Science scholars

Communication Skills
Academic · Interview · Research communication

Language & Communication for Tech Professionals

Practical, feedback-driven communication training for engineers, researchers and job seekers — academic writing, technical interviews, professional emails and presentations, anchored in real tech scenarios.

  • Academic writing: papers, abstracts and proposals
  • Interview prep: spoken English, STAR method, mock interviews
  • Emails, reports, LinkedIn profiles and slide design
  • 100% practical, with 1-on-1 recorded mock sessions
⏱ 4–8 weeks · online, live + recorded→
School Outreach
School outreach wing · Grades 3–12

DSA Code Champs

DSA's school outreach wing brings AI and coding to Grades 3–12: four progressive levels from Scratch to Python, machine learning and computer vision, delivered in schools across Chennai and online. NEP 2020-aligned and activity-first, with a special focus on girls in STEM.

  • Four levels: Code Explorers, Builders, Innovators and Pioneers
  • Scratch → Python → machine learning → computer vision
  • Fully managed school visits across Chennai, plus online live sessions
  • Level certificates, a parent showcase and a performance report for the school
⏱ 3–6 months per level · Grades 3–12→
